service_categories.name: AI Search and GEO
service_categories.short: Get your brand found, trusted and cited in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and Google AI Overviews.
service_categories.description: AVENZA's AI search services make your business easy for AI assistants to find, trust and quote. We combine technical access for AI crawlers, consistent facts about your brand, answer-first pages backed by evidence, and mentions on trusted sites, then measure how often assistants cite you against competitors.

service_categories.name: SEO
service_categories.short: Rank for the searches that bring revenue, with technical, content, local and platform-specific SEO.
service_categories.description: AVENZA's SEO services help your pages rank for the searches that lead to enquiries and sales. The work covers research into what buyers search for, technical fixes so pages can be crawled and indexed, content that answers each search fully, internal links and authority, all reported against leads rather than traffic alone.

service_categories.name: Content Marketing
service_categories.short: Research-led writing built with your experts, so people trust it, search engines rank it and AI tools quote it.
service_categories.description: AVENZA's content services plan, write and refresh the pages, articles and assets your buyers read before they decide. Every piece starts from a real question, draws on interviews with your specialists, cites its sources and is structured so readers, search engines and AI assistants can use it easily.

service_categories.name: Digital PR and Reputation
service_categories.short: Earn the links, mentions and reviews that prove your expertise to buyers, search engines and AI assistants.
service_categories.description: AVENZA's digital PR and reputation services build the outside proof that search engines and AI assistants rely on. We earn coverage and links through data stories and expert commentary, fix listings and citations, and help you collect and answer reviews, always within the rules of Google and each platform.

service_categories.name: Paid Media and PPC
service_categories.short: Search, Shopping, video and marketplace ads run against tracked leads and revenue, not clicks.
service_categories.description: AVENZA's paid media services plan, build and manage advertising on Google, Microsoft, YouTube, Amazon and programmatic networks. Every account starts with accurate conversion tracking, then campaigns are structured by intent, written to match each search and tuned every week against cost per lead or return on ad spend.

service_categories.name: Social Media Marketing
service_categories.short: Organic content, short video, creators and paid social on the platforms your buyers actually use.
service_categories.description: AVENZA's social media services build demand where buyers first discover brands. We plan content around your audience, produce short video and posts with your team, manage communities and run paid campaigns on Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube and Pinterest, with tracking that ties results to enquiries and sales.

service_categories.name: Websites and Development
service_categories.short: Fast, accessible websites and stores, built clean for search and AI crawlers and easy for your team to edit.
service_categories.description: AVENZA's website services design, build, speed up and look after websites and online stores on WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify and modern frameworks. Every build is mobile-first, accessible to WCAG 2.2, technically clean for search and AI crawlers, and handed over with training so your team can edit it.

service_categories.name: CRO and Analytics
service_categories.short: Measure what matters, find where visitors leave, and turn more of them into leads and customers.
service_categories.description: AVENZA's conversion and analytics services make sure every enquiry and sale is measured correctly, then find and fix what stops visitors from acting. The work covers GA4 and tag setup, dashboards, call and conversion tracking, attribution, user research, landing page and checkout improvements, and honest A/B testing.

service_categories.name: Email and Automation
service_categories.short: Email, SMS and CRM automation that nurtures leads and brings customers back, sent with consent.
service_categories.description: AVENZA's email and automation services set up and run the messages that turn enquiries into customers and customers into repeat buyers. We plan journeys, write and design emails, connect your CRM and forms, handle deliverability and consent, and report on revenue and pipeline rather than open rates alone.

service_categories.name: E-commerce and Marketplaces
service_categories.short: Grow sales on your own store and on Amazon and Flipkart, with clean feeds, strong listings and sharp offers.
service_categories.description: AVENZA's e-commerce growth services help brands sell more on their own store and on marketplaces such as Amazon and Flipkart. We manage listings, product feeds, store setup, pricing visibility and customer journeys, and connect marketplace data with your own analytics so you can see what truly drives profit.
